title: "FreaxMATE"

Welcome to FreaxMATE! This is a personal website featuring articles about Linux, Physics, and modern documentation techniques using Quarto.

## Sections

- **[Linux](docs/linux/index.html)** - Guides and tutorials for Linux systems, including distribution customization and development tools
- **[Physics](docs/physics/index.html)** - Physics concepts and derivations from thermodynamics to solid state physics  
- **[Quarto Features](docs/quarto-features/index.html)** - Showcase of Quarto capabilities and interactive notebooks

## About

This site demonstrates the power of Quarto for creating modern, interactive technical documentation with integrated Jupyter notebooks, scientific equations, and beautiful styling.
